open_science_requirements: Training activities must foster the culture of Open Science, including knowledge valorisation, and when applicable innovation and entrepreneurship, as well as good scientific conduct such as research integrity (CC-09, SR-04).
Career Development Plan must include participation in public engagement and Open Science activities (CC-10, SR-05).
Fellows must be adequately prepared for Open Access to publications and research outputs, FAIR data management, collaborative digital tools, societal engagement, and citizen science (CC-15, SR-06).
